# Xahau ledger object fixtures: findings

Recorded 2026-10-29 from `wss://xahau.network` (xahaud 2026.10.13-release+4119, network id 21337; validated head 26873124) with `--txs` and `--delay-ms 1000`: 12 ledgers, 12 transactions (1.36 MB gzipped, largest 321 KB, ledger 20555633), the 11 cases of `manifest.json` and one supporting transaction, the EVR token cash `2615DA09A9FB5E0F919EE108066407A518771B63541BCA51DEB10B96D9FFA026` (ledger 26399329). Every fact says how it was checked, with throwaway scripts (not in the repository) on the recorded ledgers and on the node. `src/ingest/object-fixtures.spec.ts` pins what each case is for. Questions (1), (2), (3), (6), (7) and (8) are XRPL's (`xrpl/objects/FINDINGS.md`); this page answers (4) and (5) and lists what differs on Xahau.

## Where the cases came from

- **Scan.** One script read 999 validated ledgers back from 26872090 (26872090 to 26871091): a hash list first, then the transactions of the 604 ledgers with at most 80 of them; the 348 ledgers above that (Evernode bursts of 90 to 200 transactions) were not read, and ledger 26871938 the node did not hold. It kept every Escrow, Check and PaymentChannel transaction and every transaction that touches such a node: there was none. The node throttles by units, and this is the ruling's whole scan budget (1,000 ledgers, 1000 ms apart).
- **State walk.** The cases were therefore found in the state: `ledger_data` with `binary: true` and `limit: 2048`, one request at a time, 1 s apart, 393 requests, 804,801 entries of ledger 26872617, decoding only the entries of type Escrow, PayChannel, Check and Delegate with the node's `server_definitions`. It found 198 Escrow, 13 PayChannel, 6 Check and no Delegate entries. The `PreviousTxnID` of an Escrow is its `EscrowCreate`.
- **Account histories.** `account_tx` (two pages of 400 at most each, one request at a time) of the 83 accounts that those entries name, plus `rL6rwNe6puyoN5X1BUy8pEQb6Un23m2f1m` (DHA token channels) and `rKqZCLrHu8dMPj444xPrDQCXUpZr6U2VWi` (escrows). The node answered "units quota (50000 per 10s) exhausted, retry in ~N ms" now and then; the script waited it out. They hold 468 successful EscrowCreate, 323 EscrowFinish, 85 PaymentChannelClaim, 51 PaymentChannelCreate, 16 CheckCreate, 4 CheckCash, 2 EscrowCancel and 1 CheckCancel.
- **Supporting transaction:** the token cash `2615DA09…` shows a cash of an issued token (`Amount` 0.001 EVR; a created `RippleState` for the receiver and the payer's line debited).

## Findings

### (4) Xahau's Escrow fields, and an EscrowFinish with EscrowID

- **Fields of the 198 live Escrow entries** (ledger 26872617): `Account`, `Destination`, `Amount`, `FinishAfter` (198 of 198), `CancelAfter` (10), `TransferRate` (198, always 1000000000, "no fee"), `OwnerNode`, `DestinationNode` (82: exactly the escrows whose `Destination` is another account; 0 of the 116 to self), `Flags` (always 0), `SourceTag` (2), `DestinationTag` (1), `PreviousTxnID`, `PreviousTxnLgrSeq`. No `Condition` (0 of 198), no `IssuerNode` on any, not even on the 15 token escrows. `TransferRate` is also in the `NewFields` of a created escrow (`escrow_create`, ledger 14634228). 183 hold XAH, 11 EVR (issuer `rEvernodee8dJLaFsujS6q1EiXvZYmHXr8`), 2 CLV, 2 a 40-hex currency (`0000…5852500000…`, issuer `rhub8VRN55s94qWKDv6jmDy1pUykJzF3wq`).
- **A token escrow locks the tokens on the trust line** (`escrow_create_token`, ledger 25229443, 80875 CLV): the sender's `RippleState` is a ModifiedNode whose `PreviousFields` are empty; it gains `LockCount` 1 and `LockedBalance` -80875 and its `Balance` does not move. The tokens are not taken out of the line, they are locked on it (the same holds for token channels, below). Task 5's balance changes for a Xahau token escrow therefore see no `Balance` change at create.
- **EscrowFinish.** Normally `Owner` and `OfferSequence` (`escrow_finish`, ledger 20555633), sent by the owner or anyone. Of the 234 successful EscrowFinish read, 99 also carry a `PreviousTxnID` field, always equal to the escrow's own; 233 have `Owner` equal to the escrow's `Account`.
- **With `EscrowID`** (`escrow_finish_escrow_id`, `D1B7A0AD6C6DA3551F97F1C63E4035DABC7C58AE21F9F758090C588B824973BA`, ledger 10090323; the only one in the histories read): `EscrowID` "10C5F525E3D07CAC9CD2BF3F53367653504B7D8A54451E311F5B38E70442457F" and no `OfferSequence`. Its `Owner` is `rPicqzcyoxw22XBrFCMAcFXYU2boeqYjm6`, which is the escrow's `Destination`, not its owner: the DeletedNode `Escrow` has `Account` `rD74dUPRFNfgnY2NzrxxYRXN4BrfGSN6Mv` (13370 XAH, `FinishAfter` 783730800, created by `17FD57E5…` in ledger 8942030). So with an `EscrowID` the escrow has to be found as the DeletedNode whose `LedgerIndex` is that id, and `Owner` must not be trusted. `EscrowID` is a defined field (`server_definitions`, Hash256).
- EscrowCancel (`escrow_cancel`, ledger 20449602) by a third party: `Account` `r42noEGv…` differs from `Owner` `rN2DeuLy…`.

### (5) Xahau's first ledger, and Escrow, PayChan and Checks in the Amendments object

Answered offline (no Xahau request for it).

- The first ledger is 1: `xahau/uritoken/FINDINGS.md` item 1 (checked 2026-10-26: `complete_ledgers` starts at 1; ledger 1 has `close_time` 0, hash `AEDC861F60683C91EB9D517A40D207F37B4F07E5141358DAE1ED3D8195728094`). The `server_info` that this recording stored says the same (`complete_ledgers` "1-26873124"). It equals `firstLedger` of the `xahau` profile: 1 (`src/network/network-profile.ts`, asserted in `network-profile.spec.ts`).
- `xahau/network-state/amendments.json` (the `Amendments` object at ledger 26633715, 75 amendments): `Checks` (`157D2D480E006395B76F948E3E07A45A05FE10230D88A7993C71F97AE4B1F2D1`) is listed; `Escrow` (`07D43DCE529B15A10827E5E04943B496762F9A88E3268269D69C44BE49E21104`) and `PayChan` (`08DE7D96082187F6E6578530258C77FAABABE4C20474BDB82F04B021F1A68647`) are not (checked by id). They are retired amendments (always on): escrows and channels work from the start of the history read here (the earliest EscrowCreate in the histories is ledger 1846060, 2024-01-02; the earliest PaymentChannelCreate 8091397; neither is the first on the network). `PaychanAndEscrowForTokens` (`919857E4…`) is in the list and enabled.

### Differences the other cases show

- **A created PayChannel has `Balance` "0" and `TransferRate` 1000000000 in its `NewFields`** (`channel_create`, ledger 8852809). On XRPL a created channel has no `Balance`. The first claim still has `PreviousFields.Balance` "0": 15 of 15 first claims in the histories read (`channel_claim`, ledger 8863640).
- **Token channels** (`channel_create_token`, ledger 11056548; 1 DHA, issuer `rDyz9rX7eGJRdVDC8NGxMxqh9U14qduqzS`): the created PayChannel's `Amount` and `Balance` are token amounts (`Balance` `{DHA, "0"}`), and the creator's `RippleState` gains `LockCount`/`LockedBalance` (-4.978119 to -5.978119) with its `Balance` unchanged. The first claim (`channel_claim_token`, ledger 11083603, `Balance` 0.023506 DHA) has `PreviousFields.Balance` `{DHA, "0"}` and moves two trust lines: the creator's (`LockedBalance` -5.978119 to -5.954613, `Balance` -9997.999123 to -9997.975617 seen from the issuer side) and the destination's (0 to -0.023506). A parser that calls `dropsToNative` on a channel's `Amount` throws on these (plan conflict C3).
- **Checks.** `check_cash` (`11B73A143945187700479CA7B6965F763DB6FCD04244E48A227B68F54055F89C`, ledger 12064524) is a cash with `DeliverMin` "1000000" and no `Amount`, of the check created by `check_create` 13 ledgers earlier; its stored metadata has `DeliveredAmount` "1000000". The only DeliverMin cash found on either network.
- Every Xahau transaction carries `NetworkID` 21337.

## Not found

Every case of this set was found. Xahau has no conditional escrow among its 198 live ones (none has a `Condition`), no MPT and no `Delegate` entry, so the set has none of those.
